title: Cargo Ships Carry 24,327 Containers With Smaller Crews
hook: Cargo capacity hit 24,327 containers while crews kept shrinking.
closing: More trade now depends on fewer people aboard.
question: Would you work on this ship?

segments.say: Cargo capacity reached 24,327 containers, roughly six times the earliest ship shown.
The largest cargo ship stretches 400 meters, longer than the Titanic.
Today's cargo crew has 20 people, even as ships carry far more.
